files.name: dochi_spawn_control-0.1.3-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.3 Change Log

  • Added compatibility with Dochi's NPC Core (in development). The mod is still under development.
  • Improved the UI.
  • Added support for spawning vehicle entities from the following mods:

Forge 1.20.1

  • Immersive Vehicles (MTS)
  • Superb Warfare
  • Immersive Aircraft
  • Automobility

NeoForge 1.21.1

  • Immersive Vehicles (MTS)
  • Superb Warfare
  • Immersive Aircraft
  • Automobility

Fabric 1.21.1

  • Immersive Aircraft
  • Automobility
